redfin.remarks: Price improvement! Kentwood. Corner lot , low traffic street , nestled within the neighborhood. Inviting front porch . Freshly painted! Formal living room, open to dining area and remodeled kitchen . The remodeled kitchen has quartz counters , stainless steel appliances and a lovely bay window above the kitchen sink - perfect for plants or herbs. Custom cabinets, plenty of counter space and a breakfast table nook. Charming Dutch door off the kitchen makes it easy to grill on the deck outback and entertain. Custom window shutters and blinds throughout. On the main floor are three bedrooms, the first of which has double doors that open to the living room, perfect flex space/home office. Two additional bedrooms with coved ceilings complete this level. Down the hall is a great room/den with cozy window seat with storage underneath, tall ceiling with oversized fan, and a staircase to the 2nd level. The den opens to the backyard through sliding doors and is large enough for a comfy sectional sofa or pool/ping pong table or exercise room. Convenient 3/4 bath located under the stairs. Direct access garage with off street parking. Upstairs is a primary suite with large walk-in closet and views out the windows of the neighborhood. The second bedroom could be used as a nursery or office/workout room. Full bathroom completes this level. Layout may work for multigenerational family too! Two HVAC systems - one for the main level and another for upstairs. Dual paned windows, plantation shutters. Direct access garage with laundry area plus room for storage. Close to Silicon Beach yet also conveniently located near LAX. Or, jump on bikes and enjoy the local parks, shopping and dining. Fantastic location -- short commute to Loyola Marymount University, Kentwood Elementary School and the charm of Westchester. Just reduced by 50k!
